import unreal
lib=unreal.EditorAssetLibrary
D='/Game/P4/Meshy'
old=D+'/PA_P4_Meshy'
if lib.does_asset_exist(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy_PhysicsAsset'):
    if lib.does_asset_exist(old): lib.delete_asset(old)
    print('A28 Meshy pa rename', lib.rename_asset(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy_PhysicsAsset', old))
pa=lib.load_asset(old); mesh=lib.load_asset(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy')
mesh.set_editor_property('physics_asset', pa)
lib.save_asset(D+'/SK_P4_Meshy', only_if_is_dirty=False); lib.save_asset(old, only_if_is_dirty=False)
print('A28 Meshy pa assigned', pa.get_path_name())
